exposure: Analysis by postpartum urinary incontinence status
outcome: Health-related quality of life (measured using the SF-36)
cohort: 546 healthy primiparae aged 18 to 45 years who gave birth to a healthy newborn in Spain
finding: While mode of birth was not directly associated with health-related quality of life at 6 weeks or 6 months postpartum, women with postpartum urinary incontinence reported lower health-related quality of life at 6 weeks.
mod_finding: Women who underwent forceps delivery were more likely to experience postpartum urinary incontinence, which was associated with lower health-related quality of life.
